title: Terry Crews Doesn't Eat Until 2 PM. He's Right.
hook: Terry Crews doesn't eat until 2 PM, and he's right.
body:
He's been doing intermittent fasting for years, and look at how muscular he is. A lot of people tell me they can't fast because they'll lose all their muscle. Fasting does not make you lose muscle. Get that out of your head.

Your body adapts to it over time, and it actually becomes easy. Fasting also lets you eat a big dinner with all your favorite foods and still hit your calories for the day. If you're not fasting, you're going to have to have a much smaller dinner, which for me is much harder.
close: If you want to learn how to get started with intermittent fasting, subscribe to my channel.
pinned_comment: What time do you eat your first meal of the day?
